title: ShieldScan Model Evaluation Flow
description: Complete flow showing how the ML model is trained, evaluated, and metrics are stored

steps.name: Dataset Load
steps.description: CSV se 60 features + type column load hoti hai. type me 'benign' ya 'phishing' values hain.

steps.name: Train/Test Split
steps.description: 80% training, 20% test data. stratify=y ensures class ratio same rahe dono sets mein.

steps.name: Model Training
steps.description: Random Forest classifier train hota hai training data par. Fast mode: n_estimators=200, max_depth=15.

steps.name: Calibration
steps.description: Sigmoid calibration se predicted probabilities ko real-world probabilities mein convert karta hai. Is se risk_score aur confidence accurate hotay hain.

steps.name: Model Evaluation
steps.description: Trained model ko test set par evaluate karta hai. Ye function internally ye karta hai: y_pred = model.predict(X_test), y_prob = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1], phir sklearn k functions se ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, classification_report, confusion_matrix compute hoti hai.

steps.name: Save in Bundle
steps.code: bundle = make_bundle(calibrated_model, selected_name, cv_auc, metrics, X_test, y_test)
steps.description: Model + features + schema_hash + sare metrics pickle format mein artifacts/phishing_model_bundle.pkl file mein save hotay hain.

steps.name: Bundle Read
steps.description: Pickle file se bundle dict load karta hai. Cached hota hai _MODEL_CACHE mein dobara load na ho.

steps.name: Metrics Extraction
steps.description: Bundle dict se 'metrics' key se evaluation results nikalte hain. Ye wahi data hai jo step 5 mein compute hua tha.

evaluate_model_function_detail.code:
def evaluate_model(model, X_test, y_test):
    y_pred = model.predict(X_test)
    y_prob = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
    report = classification_report(y_test, y_pred, output_dict=True, zero_division=0)
    roc_auc = float(roc_auc_score(y_test, y_prob))
    pr_auc = float(average_precision_score(y_test, y_prob))
    cm = confusion_matrix(y_test, y_pred).tolist()
    return {
        'classification_report': report,
        'roc_auc': roc_auc,
        'pr_auc': pr_auc,
        'confusion_matrix': cm,
    }
